name: dsh-pharos
description: DSH 桌面守望提醒：模型需要你操作（审批 / 方案确认 / 提问）或后台回复完成时，弹出系统通知与提示音，点击通知直接跳转到对应会话。另含出错 / 中断 / 用量上限提醒、安静时段、子代理过滤、当轮统计（token / 缓存命中率 / TPS）、工作流进展、SSE 桥与 Webhook（企微 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）、远程触发，以及「设置 → 消息通知」图形设置页。 Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a system toast, a per-kind chime and a title marker when the agent needs your input or a reply finishes in the background — click the notification to jump straight to that session. Also covers errors, interrupts and usage limits, with per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, workflow progress alerts, SSE bridge, Webhooks (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), remote trigger, subagent filtering and quiet hours.
author: Leo Chen (Leo-Cjw)
